points.description: Gives a first valid advantage of separating declaration from definition, such as: the code is clearer and easier for the reader to understand; or it makes code easier to change, debug or override; or it enhances modularity; or it separates the abstraction (interface) from the implementation. Equivalent wording earns the mark.

Gives a second valid advantage that is different from the first, chosen from the same list (clarity/readability; easy changing, debugging or overriding; modularity; separation of abstraction from implementation). Restating the same advantage in different words does not earn this mark.
